title: anthoxanthum hookeri
intro: Anthoxanthum hookeri, commonly known as Hooker's grass or sweet vernal grass, is a type of perennial grass belonging to the family Poaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, including its potential to help with digestion and provide relief from respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Hooker's grass are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can also aid in the treatment of skin conditions and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Hooker's grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a popular herb in traditional medicine.
